purpose: Public egress address of the owner's official personal WireGuard VPN (the Megamesh reference server). Traffic from this address since the 'since' timestamp is the owner.
rationale: A public, dated, verifiable declaration of the owner's exit address. Any log trace from another address is, by this prior declaration, not the owner on their VPN. It is leverage against calumny, fake news and false intrusion claims — not proof of innocence by itself.
since_note: Official from Sunday 18 October 2026, 17:00 Europe/Lisbon (16:00 UTC). The address was leased to someone else before that; nothing it did before this timestamp is attributable to the owner.
policy: Convenience signal, never the only control: pair any allow-list entry with authentication. Drop the entry if the PTR stops matching the hostname or if this file has not been touched for 12 months. A hosting provider can reassign an IP; this file is updated first when that happens.
